title: Ship Classification Accuracy (CNN)
summary: An image-classification deep learning project comparing a custom CNN with a VGG16 transfer-learning model.
body:
## Overview
An image classification deep learning project focused on how accurately a model can identify ships.

## What I did
- Trained a convolutional neural network model to evaluate accuracy of image classification.
- Leveraged the **VGG16** convolutional base model to compare performance with a custom-trained CNN.
- Built the project with the **Keras** API.
